blocks.html: STUDENTS FROM UST HOLDS ENTREP BAZAAR AT ROBINSONS GALLERIA

Student entrepreneurs of the prestigious University of Sto. Tomas will be holding a bazaar at Robinsons Galleria this October. Shoppers and foodies will enjoy sampling the bazaar’s wide variety of goods—from craft coffee and cupcakes to longganisa burgers and “bacon everything” finger foods— while the health-conscious can take their pick from gourmet soy smoothies, low-sugar, whole wheat fruit cookies and a wide range of epicurean salads. Both men and women can shop to their hearts content as options abound: Statement shirts for the quirky and sassy, edgy graphic shirts for artist types and high-street style clothes and shoes for the more fashion forward. As for the more discerning shoppers always looking for added value, there are artisanal natural bath soaps, theft-proof water-resistant backpacks and stylish nursing covers for urban moms. And because this generation is big on capturing moments, companies specializing in events coverage and door-to-door delivery of Polaroid-like prints will also be there to offer their services.

The USTepreneur Bazaar is a joint project of University of Santo Tomas’ College of Commerce and Business Administration and Robinsons Malls Entrep Corner. Visit the Bazaar on these dates: October 8-11, October 15-18, October 29 -November 1 and November 5 to 8. The project aims to champion the entrepreneurial spirit of the youth and provide a platform to showcase their innovative business ideas through a holistic retail experience.
